# ExcelJS

ExcelJS 4.4.0 (MIT), browser build.

- Upstream: https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs/tree/v4.4.0
- Download: https://registry.npmjs.org/exceljs/-/exceljs-4.4.0.tgz
- File: package/dist/exceljs.min.js
- License: exceljs.LICENSE

The version is vendored so export does not depend on an external CDN at runtime.
